about_the_game:
Resprite is a pixel art and sprite animation editor built for professional workflows, designed for sustained, high-frequency creative production.

If you have experience with tools such as Procreate, Aseprite, or Clip Studio Paint, you can get up to speed quickly and work within a flexible, customizable workflow. Beyond standard pixel drawing tools, Resprite emphasizes efficiency, control, and reliability when handling complex projects.

Solid core drawing tools

  • Pixel-perfect drawing
  • Dithering textures
  • Alpha lock
  • Four-way symmetry painting
  • Tiled Mode support
  • Shading Tool and Material Color Sphere support
  • Onion skinning support
  • Compatibility with Aseprite files

A flexible interface for complex workflows

  • Freely rearrange the interface layout
  • Highly customizable toolbars and action bars
  • Save and quickly switch between multiple layouts
  • Interactive theme color customization
  • Comprehensive gesture and shortcut support

Timeline for animation and multi-frame creation

  • Animation clip and frame sequence management
  • Layer clipping masks and blending modes
  • Support for multi-level animation structures
  • Onion skinning for animation workflows

Comprehensive and controllable color management

  • Freely organize and group color palettes
  • Generate color ramps through interpolation
  • Support for HSV / HSL / RGB color modes
  • Multiple color pickers, including spectrum, sliders, color wheel, and hue shifting

Advanced tools for professional pipelines

  • Interactive curve tool
  • Advanced reference image management
  • Optimized Chinese font rendering and handling
  • Import and export PSD files
  • Export video and APNG
  • Timelapse playback of the drawing process

Resprite is available on iOS and Android in addition to the Steam desktop version.

Join the community to share your work, exchange tips, and provide feedback on features.
